notes:
Three real bullets and a reward table. The header's giver is 'Reinhard, Buburimu Peninsula', but bullet 1 says you EXAMINE the Cavernous Maw at (F-7) and that Reinhard is who the cutscene is with -- he is not something you walk up to and click. So start moves to the Cavernous Maw, which is a genuine markable object standing exactly where the header wanted to send you; that is a marker move, not a removal. The [KI] Traverser stone is a real requirement but res/key_items.lua carries six ids under that one name (1271-1276), so the resolver rejects it rather than guess, and it is recorded in the note instead of items -- an unresolvable entry in items would make the step permanently un-ready. The abyssite in Reward is a nine-row table keyed on how many storyline quests you have already finished: a reward, never evidence. Bullet 2's sub-bullet punts the spawn conditions to the Abyssea - Attohwa page, so nothing about spawning Itzpapalotl is recorded here.

Adversary pass: demoted to medium, ladder left untouched. Two medium triggers were already admitted in the notes above and neither was priced in. The [KI] Traverser stone is a genuine gate on step 1 -- without one the Maw does nothing -- and it could not be modelled at all, so the step will read ready when it is not. And bullet 2 hands the whole spawn procedure for Itzpapalotl off to the Abyssea - Attohwa page, so the fight rung is incomplete by the page's own admission. The Beast of Bastore in this same batch and A Delectable Demon are the identical page shape and are both medium; high here was internally inconsistent. Every step, target, zone and bullet mapping was re-checked against the page and is correct as drafted.

notes:
Bullet 2 is what Tyamah asks for, not a second action, so it merges into the talk. Bullet 3 is a real step -- you have to collect the soulgauger and buy plates -- but the page calls the source only 'the chests next to him', so the target is none and the note says so. Only the Soulgauger SGR-1 is used as its evidence: the twelve Blank Gauger Plates are ammunition (res id 18680, stack 12) and are spent taking pictures, so an AND-list over them would read false halfway through the quest for no gain. Bullet 4's four monsters are an unordered set -- the page says 'for each of the following' and gives four unrelated corners of the zone -- so they are four grouped steps that all draw at once rather than a ladder that would mark one murex and hide the rest. The four-plate evidence sits on the LAST group member only: duplicate evidence across steps is a hard gate, and putting it last is what lands the mark back on Tyamah rather than inside the group. That evidence is imperfect and flagged: a Gauger Plate is one item id (2480) with no per-monster distinction, so four plates of the wrong four monsters would read as done. It is still the only observable this quest has. The sub-sub-bullets are directions and stay as notes.

notes:
A weapon-skill quest, so the shape is: get the trial weapon, break its latent somewhere off-page, bring it back, then a spawn-fight-reexamine loop in a dungeon. Bullet 1 is a precondition about not holding two WS quests at once, not an action. Bullet 4 is Unity Warp advice and bullet 5 is a route, so both fold into the note on the ??? step. The one judgement call worth arguing over is the latent: it is a real piece of work the page insists on ('You will need to break the latent ... before completing the rest of the quest'), and it genuinely sits between two visits to Jaucribaix, so it keeps a rung even though it is unmarkable and unobservable -- the sub-bullet that should explain it is a transclusion and rendered empty. The page writes the key item 'Weapons Training Guide'; the game's key item is 'Weapon training guide' (id 343, singular), and the resolving form is what is recorded. The Tachi of Trials is granted at the same moment but is traded away three steps later, so only the guide is evidence. 'Quest Reqs: Great Katana skill 250+' has no slot in the schema and no observable predicate; the Level 71 half of it is a real gate and is recorded.

Adversary pass: demoted to medium, ladder left untouched. The notes and review flags already state two things the confidence table calls medium outright: the 'Breaking the Latent' sub-section is a transclusion that rendered empty, so the walkthrough is literally incomplete exactly where step 2 lives, and 'Great Katana skill 250+' is a gate with no slot in the schema and no observable predicate. Every other Weapon Skill quest of this shape in the corpus is medium for these same two reasons. Re-checked and left alone: evidence sits on the step that grants it in all three cases, no item is evidence twice, the Tachi of Trials is correctly items-only, and the reward (Tachi: Kasha) is nowhere near the evidence.

break the latent on the Tachi of Trials. The page's 'Breaking the Latent' sub-section is a transclusion and rendered empty, and nothing about the latent is observable, so this rung has no zone, no target and no evidence -- it exists only because the page really does put work between the two visits to Jaucribaix.

notes: A short repeatable that steps cleanly, because both of its key items resolve: the Vat of martello fuel (1559) proves the talk is done and the Empty fuel vat (1561) proves the martello is done. Six bullets collapse to three rungs -- bullet 2 is what bullet 1 gives you, and bullets 4 and 5 are the menu you work through once you are already standing at a martello, so they belong to the same rung as bullet 3's 'find a Martello'. The unnumbered lead line is a cooldown, not a step: one Refuel and Replenish or A Mightier Martello per Vana'dielian day across all Abyssea areas, which no packet reports. The 'you cannot zone' warning is likewise a warning. 'Machine Outfitter' and 'Martello' are both names shared across every Abyssea area, so each step carries its zone explicitly; neither is in the ambiguous-name list, and with the zone resolved they mark correctly. The martello marker deliberately covers all of them -- the page says any one in the zone will do.

steps.note: near the zone entrance; choose 'Assist with replenishment'. Zoning at any point after this loses the vat and you start over. Only one of these per Vana'dielian day, which is not observable.

any martello in the zone -- they cluster around the Confluxes, and one already at full health still counts. Choose 'Prepare to replenish martello', confirm, then stand in the direction the MENU gives; the log gives a different one and is wrong. The vat quietly becomes an Empty fuel vat, which the page only mentions in a sub-bullet.
the cruor paid depends on which martello you chose -- a reward, not a step
